segments.text:
V. 28.
In the renovation—In the final Renovation: Ye ſhall ſit—In the Beginning of the Judgment they ſhall ſtand (2 Cor. v. 10.) Then being abſolved, they ſhall ſit with the Judge: (1 Cor. vi. 2.) On twelve thrones—So our LORD promiſed, without expreſſing any Condition: Yet as abſolute as the Words are, it is certain, there is a Condition implied, as in many Scriptures, where none is expreſt. In conſequence of this, theſe twelve did not ſit on thoſe twelve thrones: For the Throne of Judas another took, ſo that he never ſat thereon.
